reason: Ranked first the small changes that preserve the existing FP32 tile and layout, then schedule and packing changes with greater uncertainty or setup cost. compiler_codegen and address_generation have low correctness risk and isolate address work; the compiler may already optimize it. tail_alignment and the n=512 paths could reduce loop overhead but overlap the prior constant-bound trial, which passed correctness without timing. Tile reuse, register reuse, and K blocking may affect locality or code generation without established evidence. B packing is ranked below A packing because it adds a read and write of each B panel and B is already reused from cache across row tiles. Fused transpose, output copying, and scalar loop-order changes make larger structural changes and carry greater performance risk. Historical scores are noisy battery measurements, so none establish gains or causality.
